howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会把 Slack 适配器复制进项目、注册并安装固定版本的依赖包,再引导你创建 Slack 应用、填入令牌,重启服务后机器人即可收发 Slack 消息。

howto.what_en: Claude copies the Slack adapter into the project, registers it and installs the pinned package, then walks you through creating a Slack app, storing tokens, and restarting the service so the bot can send and receive messages.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you want to add a Slack channel to NanoClaw or run /setup. It first asks whether Slack should deliver events via Socket Mode or a webhook.
